checks.name: All map sizes and player counts create unique sea harbors, one home per player and separate starting credits
Capturing costs one combat action, no credits or oil, and does not grant immediate income
An enemy ship inside the harbor perimeter blocks capture without spending action or resources
Faraway, held, sunk, wrong-owner and spent-action capture commands reject atomically
Income belongs to the incoming player and cycles preserve the faction oil50 rule
Repair restores at most fourHP with two credits perHP and consumes the ships combat action
Unaffordable repair and wrong harbor commands cannot heal, revive or charge resources
Reinforcements replace a lost hull at an unoccupied sea berth and cannot act early or inherit cooldowns
Each harbor supports only one replacement per round and rejects live hulls or unaffordable types
No berth means no charge, no replacement, and no production quota consumption
A destroyed carriers replacement cannot inherit its old airborne wing
A player without hulls remains in play while owning a harbor and can recover through reinforcements
Portless players with no surviving hulls are eliminated and skipped by turn rotation
An air strike sinking a portless players last hull eliminates that player while other factions continue
Capturing the last defended home wins by headquarters even when the opponent still has ships
Losing the last harbor after losing all ships triggers elimination victory
Finished matches freeze air movement and reject fresh launches and commands
Unexplored harbors stay hidden and stale discovery does not reveal unseen enemy ownership changes
Version12 migration retains hull, aircraft, oil and discovery while initializing only campaign fields
Capturing a harbor raises the shared oil ceiling without granting immediate oil; next own turn fills the new ceiling
The expanded oil pool can pay more than fifty DD movement steps within visible adjacent sea cells
Losing a harbor reduces its former owners ceiling and clamps only excess oil
Harbor bonuses do not increase or refill aircraft action points and flights still spend only their own budget
Version13 offshore ports relocate to coast while ownership, quota, funds, forces, aircraft and exploration survive migration
Current saves reject oil above the owning factions derived harbor capacity without mutating input
Corrupt campaign states reject without changing the original match or caller data
